value: COMMENT ON TABLE "EventBusMessage" IS E'保存可由所有订阅实例独立读取的广播事件'
COMMENT ON COLUMN "EventBusMessage"."Id" IS E'主键标识ID'
COMMENT ON COLUMN "EventBusMessage"."Scope" IS E'所属广播范围'
COMMENT ON COLUMN "EventBusMessage"."Position" IS E'范围内遵循提交顺序的读取位置'
COMMENT ON COLUMN "EventBusMessage"."EventId" IS E'广播事件标识'
COMMENT ON COLUMN "EventBusMessage"."EventName" IS E'共享事件类型的完整名称'
COMMENT ON COLUMN "EventBusMessage"."Payload" IS E'使用统一约定序列化的事件参数'
COMMENT ON COLUMN "EventBusMessage"."CreateTime" IS E'创建时间'
COMMENT ON COLUMN "EventBusMessage"."DeleteTime" IS E'删除时间，不为 null 时表示已软删除'
COMMENT ON TABLE "EventBusStream" IS E'通过提交顺序维护广播范围的最新位置'
COMMENT ON COLUMN "EventBusStream"."Id" IS E'主键标识ID'
COMMENT ON COLUMN "EventBusStream"."Scope" IS E'互通实例共用的广播范围'
COMMENT ON COLUMN "EventBusStream"."Position" IS E'当前已经提交的最大事件位置'
COMMENT ON COLUMN "EventBusStream"."CreateTime" IS E'创建时间'
COMMENT ON COLUMN "EventBusStream"."DeleteTime" IS E'删除时间，不为 null 时表示已软删除'
